- move end back if splits pair
- reject nonempty read that can't make progress without splitting: if end===offset && offset<text.length → error. But with max>=1, end>offset always unless... end=min(len, offset+max). If offset<len, end≥offset+1. Splitting back could make end==offset only if offset+1 was a split position and... if end==offset+1 and splitPair(end) → end becomes offset, then no progress → reject. Good.

Also need(!splitPair(end)) after moving end back. Contract says "move an interior end backward" — so adjust end rather than reject. If end==offset+1 splits and end-1==offset → progress check fails → reject.
